measurement.outer_timer: Registered proof component from raw inner-proof witness inputs through BatchProof construction and completed execution report, including fresh private seed import, GPU FRI and public proof-field reads. Approved public preparation is timed separately per fresh process.
outside_outer_timer: Independent CPU preprocessing reconstruction and proof verification

limitations: Registered single-wallet verifier proof, not production wrapper/merge aggregation, worker-pool throughput or a transaction-per-hour estimate.

No paired baseline or CPU/OpenCL proving comparison is included. The registered timer includes seed imports and report finalization, unlike earlier raw-engine timings. Small differences from the prior benchmark do not establish a performance improvement or regression.

Each sample uses fresh preparation. The interface tests qualify authenticated preparation and reuse after failure, but this benchmark does not time failed-attempt retries or a persistent-worker cache.
Focused ownership-path race checks passed; full-size recursive race instrumentation remains incomplete as recorded in the qualification.
Only the desktop RTX 5080 was measured. Larger domains and other GPUs require separate admission and qualification.
